title: Haitian Creole 2: Everyday Grammar & Sentence Building
subtitle: Extend your foundations into more precise everyday Kreyòl.
description: An A1 continuation of Haitian Creole Foundations that adds article selection, contracted pronouns, deeper possession, expanded questions, health language, past and future time, and natural descriptions without reteaching Course 1.
audience: Learners who completed Haitian Creole Foundations or already control equivalent A0-to-A1 material.
Learners who want to make everyday Kreyòl sentences more precise without restarting beginner greetings, numbers, or first-conversation material.
prerequisites: Haitian Creole Foundations or equivalent ability with greetings, introductions, basic objects and actions, core questions, beginner numbers and time, and a first everyday conversation.
Familiarity with yon, plural yo, basic possessor-after-noun phrases, Èske, Ki kote, Ki moun, Konbyen, present-progressive ap, and basic se identity statements.
goals: Choose source-supported singular definite article forms a, la, an, lan, and nan.
Use contracted object pronouns and deeper possession patterns.
Ask for more specific information and handle simple body and health exchanges.
Talk about past and future actions with te and pral.
Describe people and things naturally with Week 7 description patterns, ye, and useful adjectives.
